name: EPITA School of Engineering and Computer Science
description: Founded in 1984, EPITA is a renowned bilingual Graduate School of Computer Engineering situated in Paris. It is a member of IONIS Education Group, the leading private higher education group, with some 20 schools and educational institutions.

details.label: History
details.content: Born in 1984, EPITA (from the French Ecole pour l'Informatique et les Techniques Avancées : School of Computer Science & Advanced Techniques) has been steadily gaining a reputation of excellence among multinational companies, which often recruit our students before the end of their studies.

details.label: Education
details.content: Born with the expansion of new technologies, EPITA has kept pace with their evolution. The courses, though very technical at the beginning, have opened up a great deal even as the technical complexity has increased. EPITA took the opposite approach of the one adopted by most other engineering schools: whereas the latter allowed computer science in to try to give it a place, EPITA brought in the other sciences to join information technology and yet without losing any of its main competences that constitute its strength and identity.In permanent contact with the business world, EPITA also shares its values: pragmatism, responsible risk-taking, and innovative spirit.

details.label: Research
details.content: Allowing students to work in optimal conditions is EPITA's first concern. Faculty, administrative staff, technical resources and research facilities are all directed towards the success of EPITA students who are to become the best recognized professionals in their field of expertise.EPITA provides opportunities to be intimately involved in cutting-edge research with an intellectually diverse faculty capable of not only individual academic excellence but that can also create and apply knowledge as part of an interdisciplinary research team.

details.label: Career
details.content: As one of France's leading science and engineering schools, EPITA is committed to ensuring that all students have meaningful opportunities for personal growth and professional achievement in the future.Built around the real needs of the business world, the EPITA curriculum is designed to meet its expectations. Being so involved in the teaching content and process, companies logically offer among the highest salaries upon graduation and year after year, they ranked the school among the very best.

details.label: Accreditation
details.content: The French State organisation called CTI (Commission des Titres d’Ingenieurs) has renewed its trust in EPITA by extending its accreditation to deliver EPITA’s Computer Science Engineering Graduate Degree (recognized as a Master’s Degree) for a maximum possible duration, i.e. 3 years, for repositioning on the periodic accreditation of Paris region.This institutional recognition of the quality of training provided by EPITA, combined with ongoing support from thousands of companies that offer internships and jobs to our students each year, rewards the investment of teachers, researchers as well as the administrative staff of the school.

stats.label: Campus life
stats.content: In Paris and other major cities in France, EPITA strives to ensure a high quality educational experience that is particularly well-adapted to the demands of the digital world.Since September 2017, the EPITA integrated preparatory cycle is offered in 4 new French cities in addition to Paris. Lyon, Rennes, Strasbourg and Toulouse have opened their doors to the school’s future engineers for an unforgettable academic adventure identical to that in Paris. All the courses offered are in French and these new regional campuses will allow more students to enjoy the EPITA experience, giving them the chance to realize their most ambitious dreams.

name: EPLO/ European Law and Governance School (ELGS)

details.label: Education

Equipped with the knowledge, insights, and expertise requisite for success in today's dynamic world, our meticulously curated study programmes in Berlin present a transformative educational experience. Our institute offers an ideal environment for personal and professional growth, whether your aspirations revolve around exploring cutting-edge technology, venturing into entrepreneurship, or harnessing the power of innovation.

details.label: Career
details.content: Our commitment to eiIET students extends beyond the classroom. We are dedicated to facilitating both your professional and personal growth, along with the acquisition of knowledge. Our institution catalyses your development, offering a nurturing environment where you can thrive. We regularly host career fairs and networking events, recognising that education is essential for a fulfilling career. These programmes establish connections between our students and entrepreneurs, startups, and potential employers, providing invaluable opportunities to kick-start your professional journey. We support your growth and introduce you to a world of possibilities.

stats.label: Campus life
stats.content: We warmly invite you to explore the European Institute of Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Technology (eiIET). A prestigious institute ideally nestled at Lessingstraße 79, 13158 Berlin, Germany. name: European Leadership University
description: European Leadership University is a New Generation University. We aim to bridge the skills gap in the tech field through a unique educational model that helps you to get the most wanted, job-ready skills.

details.label: History
details.content: We’ve built European Leadership University to bridge the skills gap that businesses currently face. We do this by engaging with employers and developing talent to give them the skills they need now. Our aim is simple in design but ambitious in scope – to invest in talent for the fourth industrial revolution.

details.label: Education
details.content: Our approach and methodology is rooted in a core activity – the full-stack education programme. By organising and facilitating these programmes, we offer an intensive learning experience: multidisciplinary teams help our students with mentoring and in-depth collaboration with the business community. When you study with ELU you can be sure that our programmes are in line with the latest developments in digital technology – developing optimum capability to devise innovative solutions. All programmes are digital-related.

details.label: Career
details.content: ELU’s unique learning experience sets you free to discover the career you want – not the career that someone else wants you to do. We place the student at the heart of our process, consciously matching you with employers who will generate mutual advantage. No more working in dead-end jobs while waiting for something better to come along. With our career-focused approach, you’ll leave university with a clear idea of where you can best take your skills – and it’s highly possible that you’ll have a job waiting for you when you leave.

details.label: Accreditation
details.content: European Leadership University (ELU) has been accredited by the Accreditation Service for International Schools, Colleges & Universities (ASIC), making it the first international accreditation for the institution.

name: European University Cyprus (EUC)
description:
European
University Cyprus (EUC) is a leading institution of higher education with over
60 years of history and a vibrant community of 12,600+ students from more than
70 countries. Ranked the among the top 501-500 universities globally in
Medicine, Dentistry, and Health Sciences by THE WUR by Subject and rated Five

Teaching, Employability, Global Engagement, and MD Medicine.

Schools of Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary Medicine, Sciences, Business, Law,

Part of

details.label: Top reasons to study here
details.content: Ranked among the top 801–1000 globally and 501–600 in Medicine, Dentistry & Health Sciences (THE WUR), EUC stands among Europe’s most dynamic institutions.  EUC offers 29 Medical & Health Sciences programs in Cyprus and at its Frankfurt campus, combining innovative learning with extensive clinical training..  With 12,600 students from 80+ countries, EUC offers a multicultural environment and EU-recognised degrees that boost employability and global careers.

details.label: History
details.content: With more than 60-years of history and over 12,600+ students from around the world, EUC has evolved into a leading academic and research institution in the region. The university comprises Schools of Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, Dentistry, Sciences, Business, Law, and Humanities, Social & Education Sciences, along with a Distance Education Unit. Dedicated to teaching excellence and research innovation, EUC has experienced remarkable growth over the past decade. As part of Galileo Global Education, Europe’s largest higher education group—with over 300,000 students across 54 institutions worldwide—EUC benefits from a truly global academic network.

details.label: Education
details.content: EUC is ranked among the top 3% of universities worldwide in the Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings and among the top 501-500 universities globally in Medicine, Dentistry, and Health Sciences by THE WUR by Subject. The university has also been rated Five Stars overall by QS Stars University Ratings 2024, receiving top scores in Teaching, Employability, Global Engagement, Diversity and Inclusion, Online Learning, and MD Medicine.Through state-of-the-art facilities, world-class faculty, and innovative teaching methods, EUC delivers programs aligned with European and international standards across its Schools of Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, Dentistry, Sciences, Business, Law, and Humanities, Social & Education Sciences, as well as a Distance Education Unit. Building on this success, EUC has expanded internationally, with its Frankfurt Campus operating in the heart of central Europe. The EUC School of Medicine in Frankfurt offers high-quality medical education within one of Europe’s most dynamic healthcare environments.

details.label: Research
details.content: European University Cyprus (EUC) conducts basic and applied research across diverse disciplines, including science, technology, health, and the arts. The university emphasizes the integration of research and teaching, ensuring that students engage with innovation and real-world applications. EUC’s academics and researchers actively seek international collaborations and opportunities for commercialization of research outcomes that contribute to social and economic progress. EUC also promotes outreach initiatives that encourage young people to pursue careers in research and innovation. Over the past decade, EUC’s research output has expanded significantly, achieving an average annual growth rate of at least 10% in external research funding and high-quality journal publications — a testament to the university’s strong research culture and global impact.

details.label: Career
details.content: At European University Cyprus (EUC), employability is a central pillar of the student experience. With a 97% graduate employment rate within six months of graduation, EUC is recognized for producing highly skilled, work-ready graduates.Through career exhibitions, internships, faculty mentoring, and skills-development workshops, students gain essential professional experience and industry insight. The EUC Career Center offers personalized career guidance and practical support, maintaining strong partnerships with leading employers and organizations across the public- and private-sector organizations. As an official EURES Network Partner, EUC connects students and graduates to employment opportunities across Europe. Career services include individual counselling, CV writing workshops, interview simulations, internship placements, entrepreneurship boot camps, and an active alumni network, empowering students to achieve professional success locally and internationally.

details.label: Accreditation
details.content: EUC is ranked among the top 3% of universities worldwide in the Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings and among the top 501-500 universities globally in Medicine, Dentistry, and Health Sciences by THE WUR by Subject. The university has also been rated Five Stars overall by QS Stars University Ratings 2024, receiving top scores in Teaching, Employability, Global Engagement, Diversity and Inclusion, Online Learning, and MD Medicine.Through state-of-the-art facilities, world-class faculty, and innovative teaching methods, EUC delivers programs aligned with European and international standards across its Schools of Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, Dentistry, Sciences, Business, Law, and Humanities, Social & Education Sciences, as well as a Distance Education Unit.Building on this success, EUC has expanded internationally, with its Frankfurt Campus operating in the heart of central Europe. stats.content: EUC is a vibrant place to learn, grow, and connect. On campus, students experience an inspiring academic environment and a dynamic community that extends far beyond the classroom. Student life is central to the EUC experience, offering opportunities to develop leadership, communication skills, and lifelong friendships. Campus life promotes intellectual, social, and cultural growth through a wide range of clubs, organizations, and extra-curricular activities. From legal debate competitions, cultural nights, and yoga sessions to barbeques, parties, excursions, and festivals, EUC ensures that every student enjoys a rich, balanced, and memorable university experience.

stats.label: Sports facilities
stats.content: European University Cyprus (EUC) offers a vibrant athletic program that is an integral part of campus life. Men’s and women’s teams compete in football, futsal, basketball, volleyball, handball, track & field, tennis, badminton, and more, participating in leagues organized by the Cyprus University Sports Federation. The EUC men’s handball team also competes in the Cyprus National League. EUC boasts one of the best indoor athletic facilities in the country, while the nearby New Life Fitness Center provides students with modern fitness and wellness spaces, including an indoor heated swimming pool, state-of-the-art gym, Pilates Studio, Aerial Yoga, and aqua and performance training programs — supporting a healthy, active student lifestyle.

stats.label: Student clubs
stats.content: EUC offers a vibrant and supportive campus life that encourages personal, academic, and social growth. From arrival to graduation, students benefit from airport pickup services, orientation programs, and ongoing guidance from International Student Advisors. Cultural events, exhibitions, excursions, and festivals enrich student life, while the Indoor Athletic Center and Fitness Center

The Housing Office helps students find comfortable on- or off-campus accommodation, and the Advising Center offers academic guidance and mentoring. Accommodation in Cyprus compares very favorably to other international study destinations, offering excellent value and high living standards. Living in EUC student housing provides convenience, community, and a true home-away-from-home experience.

stats.label: Library services
stats.content: As the intellectual hub of the university, the European University Cyprus Library provides students with modern spaces for quiet study, group collaboration, and research. It offers an extensive physical collection and 24/7 digital access to global academic databases, e-journals, and e-books.

stats.label: ICT services
stats.content: European University Cyprus hosts the Start-Up Center powered by Microsoft (MIC) — the only one in Cyprus — serving as a dynamic start-up and technology hub. The MIC fosters innovation, entrepreneurship, and digital skills development, giving students and professionals access to Microsoft technologies, mentorship, and opportunities to transform ideas into real-world solutions.

stats.label: Medical services
stats.content: The First Aid and Emergency Unit at EUC provides students and staff with medical care, urgent assistance, and first aid support, while the Center for Psychological Support and Personal Development (KEPSYPA) offers confidential counseling and wellbeing services. Together, they reflect EUC’s strong commitment to the health and holistic wellbeing of its community.

name: European University Georgia

name: European University Viadrina Frankfurt (Oder)

name: Evergreen State College
description: Evergreen is a progressive, public liberal arts and sciences college located in Olympia, Washington, in the beautiful Pacific Northwest.

details.label: History
details.content: In 1971, Evergreen welcomed its first students. The 1,000-acre campus and 3,000-foot Puget Sound beachfront became a living laboratory for creative and scientific inspiration and research. Since then, the college has earned accolades from national publications; Princeton Review, Fiske Guide, U.S. News & World Report, and Sierra Magazine, regularly rank Evergreen as a top college.

details.label: Education
details.content: Evergreen attracts students inspired by the complexity of the world. Our model of learning prepares students for the way the world happens now, layering academic disciplines so students can focus on how they want to uniquely impact our ever-changing world. On a forested campus on the shores of Puget Sound, Evergreen offers two undergraduate and three master’s degrees: Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Science, Master of Environmental Studies, Master of Public Administration, and Master in Teaching.

details.label: Research
details.content: The Office of Institutional Research and Assessment works to improve educational effectiveness through the assessment of teaching and learning, the evaluation of educational practices and services, and the ongoing reporting of demographic and evaluative data for institutional decision making and external reporting.

details.label: Career
details.content: You already have, or are currently learning, the essential skills that most employers are looking for—leadership, communication, problem solving, and teamwork.Career Development Counselors can help you learn more about what’s out there, get advice about tailoring what you’ve learned, and assemble your job-getting skills.We’ll help you create the perfect package to offer a prospective employer. A career counselor can help you look through your academic and work experience with an eye towards job requirements. Be ready with mock interviews. Some people say we’re even tougher than the real thing!

details.label: Accreditation
details.content: The Evergreen State College is accredited by the Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities (NWCCU).

stats.label: Campus life
stats.content: Evergreen feels like home, but with way more options. You’ll find recreation and athletics opportunities galore, over 76 student groups and clubs, locally sourced food, great coffee, and the list goes on. This is a community made for exploring. Go on, poke around, and make our community yours.

name: Excelsia College
description: At Excelsia College we want your experience to be one of great significance and transformation. Both in and out of the classroom, our collaborative community gives you the opportunity to make friends across all schools, and to attend a variety of performances and productions throughout the year.

details.content: In all our activities, you will be challenged, stretched and encouraged to hone and develop your skills. You will be tested at each level and inspired as you strive for improvement. You will be asked to persevere, work hard and invest more of yourself.You will learn from our highly qualified faculty who posess the academic and professional experience to deliver respected and impacting programs.

details.label: Education
details.content: Whether you have decided to enrol in a Postgraduate degree to up-skill, change your career or purse personal development, we trust you will feel supported by the community within the Graduate School at Excelsia College. We understand you will be bringing family, work and other commitments with you, and have specifically designed our courses to cater to the needs of busy professionals.

details.label: Research
details.content: Excelsia College aspires to be a leading centre of research activity in the Private Higher Education sector. The College has current areas of research excellence in education, the social sciences, theology, organizational leadership, and the creative and performing arts.The College retains a strong core of research-active academics who conduct the majority of its research. This core is being strategically supported and extended through the Office of the Director of Research.

details.label: Accreditation
details.content: Excelsia College is a self-accredited authority registered by Australia’s national regulator of higher education, the Tertiary Education and Standards Agency (TEQSA).

stats.label: Campus life
stats.content: Excelsia College is located in the heart of Macquarie Park on Waterloo Road.Macquarie Park is a nationally significant research and business centre, with a number of education institutions in the area alongside specialist companies in the communications, medical research, pharmaceutical and IT&T sectors.Macquarie Park is located 12km from the Sydney CBD and 13km from Parramatta and is easily accessible by public transport including direct rail access.

stats.label: Student clubs
stats.content: The Student Representative Council (SRC) is an elected body representing students’ interests and promoting activities that benefit the College's community. Students in each discipline, including international students, elect two student representatives who will work closely with their respective Head of Schools to articulate and implement a vision for enhancing student well being and resolving issues of concern whenever they arise.

stats.label: Housing services
stats.content: Student Housing is a great place to meet other students living in Sydney. Usually accommodation is in single bedroom/study or twin-share bedrooms with individual study areas. Meals are generally served in the dining room, and there are indoor and outdoor common areas. The Housing Supervisors provide meals and take care of general household management.

stats.label: Medical services
stats.content: Excelsia College Counselling Centre is a free and confidential counselling service available to all students attending various courses offered by Excelsia College. The Centre also provides counselling services to members of the general community (by appointment and on a fee-for-service basis).

name: Fairfield University
description: The moment you arrive at Fairfield University everything feels different. Our 200-acre idyllic campus is situated on Connecticut's coastline, providing for beautiful, unforgettable surroundings. But it's more than that - it's our dedication to each and every student's personal growth that makes our environment so unique.

details.label: History
details.content: Founded in 1942 after the purchase of the adjoining estates of Jennings and Lashar off North Benson Road in Fairfield, the University has grown from an initial class of 303 undergraduate male students admitted to the College of Arts and Sciences in 1947 into a coeducational university of more than 5,000 undergraduate and graduate students.

details.content: Fairfield University's strategic vision stresses the importance of "integration" as a way of approaching education. Collaboratively, the University's focus is on producing graduates whose lives reflect personal integration, competence in multicultural understanding, and a commitment to professional responsibility.To aid this vision, Fairfield's interdisciplinary area of focus is designed to tap into our faculty's collective knowledge base, our arts and minds programming, and the curiosities of both our undergraduate and graduate students to explore a particular theme or idea.

details.label: Research
details.content: The research conducted within the College of Arts and Sciences provides undergraduate students the opportunity for faculty mentorship, active learning, and the ability to discover new knowledge while being challenged in new ways. With research being conducted across multiple disciplines, students have the ability to engage in or develop original research projects that allow them to explore their passions while developing important industry connections and making invaluable contributions to their field of study.

details.label: Career
details.content: The Career Center serves Fairfield University students seeking academic and vocational support services through comprehensive support services, programming and resources. This integrated approach addresses the diverse developmental stages of a student’s academic career and positions Fairfield University as a leader in providing tailored services supporting personal development, academic excellence, and career readiness for a rapidly changing and evolving student body. The distinctiveness of this holistic approach is grounded in our Catholic, Jesuit mission and supports a transformative learning experience.

description: Fairleigh Dickinson University is a center of academic excellence dedicated to the preparation of world citizens through global education. The University strives to provide students with the multi-disciplinary, intercultural, and ethical understandings necessary to participate, lead, and prosper in the global marketplace of ideas, commerce, and culture.

name: Falmouth University
description:
Falmouth University is a specialist
creative center located in beautiful Cornwall, in southwest UK. Since 1902,
we’ve built a significant reputation across the breadth of the creative
industries – from traditional fine art and design to game development, robotics
and architecture. And this expertise is no longer confined to campus.

details.label: History
details.content: For more than 120 years, Falmouth University has been driving innovation in the creative industries. Founded in 1902 as Falmouth School of Art, the university has always invested in the future of the creative sector. With professional-standard facilities, academics that are experienced and passionate about their subjects within a vibrant, creative community.

details.label: Research
details.content: Our researchers work in an environment of Open Innovation to address the grand challenges of our age. This way of working encourages us to operate across disciplines, share ideas, stimulate invention and engage in entrepreneurial activities. It recognises that ideas come from many different sources and that we need to co-operate with partners from different sectors, with other businesses, markets and end-users.

details.label: Career
details.content: Our industry connections, professional facilities, in-house agencies and challenge-led approach to teaching mean our students are doing it for real from day one. Whether it’s paid opportunities through our Employability Service, an international placement or our program of guest lecturers, we empower our students to carve out successful, entrepreneurial careers by giving them a head start in industry. We know that in today’s workplace it’s important to be flexible. So in addition to our on-campus portfolio of degrees, we also offer online undergraduate and postgraduate courses that can be completed anywhere in the world and fitted around a career or other responsibilities.

details.content: Educational Affiliate of the British Computing Society BAFTA scholarship eligible coursesARRI educational affiliate A CILECT School of Film and TelevisionScreenSkills accredited courses Falmouth University's Games Academy is ranked 13th undergraduate games school worldwide, and 11th in the world for postgraduate games courses - settling at No.1 for both undergraduate and postgraduate Games Design in England, by the Princeton Review. The Games Academy at Falmouth University is proud to be a top ranked school in the 2024 Global School Rankings by The Rookies.Achieving a top ranked status in the following categories:2024 Top Creative Schools – Concept Art2024 Top Creative Schools – Game Design & Development

stats.label: Campus life
stats.content: Falmouth University is split between two campuses, approximately four miles apart. Regular buses run between the two, with a journey time of 20-25 minutes.Penryn Campus is our larger site, and purpose-built with resources for all students. This site has our photography, filmmaking, game, fashion and business courses – as well as our sports center, performance venue and more. Falmouth Campus is a more traditional in-town campus, located in beautiful subtropical gardens. Our art, design, architecture, creative writing and illustration courses are housed in this campus. Both campuses have well-stocked libraries, cafes, extensive gardens and breakout spaces.

stats.label: Student clubs
stats.content: Our Students’ Union puts students at the heart of everything they do. Extracurricular activities can take your degree from being good, to being great. That’s why the Students' Union runs hundreds of student societies and clubs, over 1,000 activities a year, and averages around 20,000 volunteering hours.  On the clubs and societies front, there’s something for everyone - from classic groups like Fal Surf and the fundraising society to Cornish Language and Culture and the martial art Tang Soo Do. Most societies are free to try and will often become an integral part of your university life.

stats.content: Whether you want the ease of living on campus, a home just moments from the sea, or a vibrant spot in the heart of Falmouth town, we have a range of student accommodation options to suit your needs. name: Federation University Australia
description: Federation University is a leading regional institution empowering international students through inclusive, innovative education, paid Co-op internships, and career pathways. Guided by collaboration, excellence, innovation, and inclusion, we foster a vibrant, supportive campus where students thrive.

details.label: Top reasons to study here
details.content: As Australia’s leading Co-op university, our paid industry internships will see you earning and building networks before you graduate.  Smaller classes, supportive lecturers, dedicated international services, and a welcoming community make your uni experience personal from day one.  We are a top-rated university for full-time employment, meaning our graduates secure jobs and have some of the highest starting salaries in Victoria.

details.label: History
details.content: At Federation Uni, we’ve been building and supporting our community for over 150 years. We’re a big uni, with small town values, and are proud of our diverse student community.Our campuses are located across Victoria, connecting you to one of the most culturally diverse and welcoming places in Australia. Choose between picturesque regional campuses in Ballarat and Gippsland or jump into the lively atmosphere at Melbourne City Campus and nearby Berwick Campus.

details.label: Education
details.content: As Australia’s leading Co-op university, our courses are created with industry to give you in-demand knowledge, experience and confidence for a successful career.Our personalized learning environment means you won’t get lost in a crowd. Federation academics and staff know you by name and are dedicated to enhancing your study experience both in and outside of the classroom.Choose from undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Business, Education, Engineering and Science, Information Technology, Nursing, Allied Health and Social Work. We also offer pathways to uni like English language courses, Foundation Studies and Diplomas.

details.label: Research
details.content: Federation research aims to drive economic and social prosperity across the regions and communities we serve in Australia and around the world. Our research areas of focus include:Indigenous and reconciliationGlobal-regional health and wellbeingCo-operative industrial transformationSustainable environmentsAdvancing society and education

details.label: Career
details.content: Studying a Federation Co-op course means you’ll complete paid work experience during your course, making you work-ready. We help you secure internships where you’ll contribute to real projects and connect with future employers.

details.label: Accreditation
details.content: Federation University is a recipient of the Premiers award for International Education Provider of the Year at the 2025 Victorian International Education Awards. The University was also recognised for its efforts, integrating paid industry work directly into its degrees to give students authentic real-world experience and a head start in their careers. Federation has a strong reputation for teaching excellence and delivering contemporary courses with accreditations from the Australian Computer Society, Engineers Australia, the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council (ANMAC), the Australian Association of Social Workers (AASW) and more.

stats.label: Campus life
stats.content: Federation University campuses are located across Victoria, giving students lots of choice. Our Melbourne Campus places you in the heart of the city, with Berwick Campus just 30minutes away. You’ll always find something to do, exploring laneways, shopping, and attending cultural events. Meanwhile, Ballarat and Gippsland offer a more relaxed lifestyle with regional charm. Think rolling hills, natural bushland with plenty of outdoor activities. Every campus boasts modern classrooms, computer labs, state-of-the-art healthcare labs, libraries, study spaces and everything you need to feel focused and supported throughout your studies. Wherever you choose to study, every Federation campus offers the same high-quality teaching and a welcoming community.

stats.label: Sports facilities
stats.content: Joining a sports team or casual exercising with new uni friends is a great way to stay mentally and physically fit. Play for fun or unleash your competitiveness, Federation students can get involved in many activities, like cricket, futsal, netball, and badminton. Our Mt Helen Campus is also home to a Health, Sports and Aquatic Centre with a heated pool and fully equipped gym with memberships discounts available to students.

stats.label: Student clubs
stats.content: If you’re looking to connect with like-minded people, or try something new, Federation has a great range of clubs and societies to join. Each campus hosts lots of events, from Holi celebrations to Open Days, off-campus excursions and intra-campus competitions. While you focus on studies, we’ll make sure you have the support and opportunities to feel connected to the Federation community and make uni memories that last a lifetime.

stats.label: Student services
stats.content: At Federation, support comes to you. Our International Student Advisors will connect with you before you arrive, with tips on what to pack, and collect you from the airport to take you safely to your new home. Our academic support services back you up with tutoring and English language support so your studies stay on track. It’s one of the many reasons why Federation students thrive and why they’re known as a top university for student support.

stats.label: Housing services
stats.content: Get the best start to uni life by living on-campus in Fedliving accommodation. New international students can receive 50% off their on-campus rental fees for the first year of their studies (and 25% off for the second year). Fedliving provides students a safe, welcoming and fun environment with lots of support from Residential Advisors and new friends. You’ll also have the added benefit of being located a short walk from all the campus facilities you need to study (24/7 study lounges, gyms, pool and library).

stats.label: Library services
stats.content: Our contemporary libraries provide students with extensive resources and quiet spaces to focus on studies. From Peer-Assisted Study Sessions to Learning Skills Advisors, writing workshops and tutoring – our academic support services help you hone your skills and feel confident to complete assessments.
